STATE OF ILLINOIS
DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTIONS
Peter B. Bensinger Director
GENERAL OFFICE -____.
Springfield, Illinois 62706
May 18, 1972
Mr. Richard H. Golterman Under Secretary Chief Transportation Engineer Administration Building 2300 South 31st Street Springfield, Illinois
Dear Mr. Golterman:
Attention: Bureau of Planning
Re: Environmental Statement
F.A. Route 23 (U.S.Route 30) Section 22-23-12-R
Cook County
We acknowledge receipt of your letter of April 18th, reference the above.
Insofar as this office can determine, the construction of this project will present no adverse long range effect on the operation of facilities under the jurisdiction of this department.
Very truly yours,
Peter B. Bensinger
Director
